title: General Matrix is first with its badge and its category count
refs: SV-11696 (Story 6 S6-R8 S6-R11),SV-11704 (Story 8 S8-R10),SV-12458 (Story 7 S7-R1 S7-R6 S7-R9)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Note the count in the General Matrix's Categories cell on the Matrices list (for example 9).
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, which prices no category.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open Settings › Categories.
  3. Click New Category.
  4. Type a name no other category uses.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open Settings › Pricing.
  7. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  8. Open Settings › Categories.
  9. Click the new category's row.
  10. Pick matrix A in the Pricing Matrix picker.
  11. Open Settings › Pricing.
  12. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The General Matrix is the first row, with a Default badge.
  • Its Categories cell reads "All categories without a matrix" with the noted count in brackets.

Step 2:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 3:

  • The New Category page opens.

Step 4:

  • The name shows in the field.

Step 5:

  • The category is created on the General Matrix.

Step 6:

  • Settings › Pricing opens.

Step 7:

  • The General Matrix's count is one higher (for example 9 + 1 = 10).

Step 8:

  • The Categories list shows the new category.

Step 9:

  • The new category's page opens.

Step 10:

  • The category now uses matrix A.

Step 11:

  • Settings › Pricing opens.

Step 12:

  • The General Matrix's count is back to the noted number (10 − 1 = 9).
